legal: Possessing, posting or carrying psilocybin mushrooms is a crime in many places, and sending a sample to a lab can be too. This page is not legal advice, gives no sourcing information, and listing a service is not an endorsement. Check the service's current rules and your local law before doing anything.
what_a_test_tells: A lab potency test measures psilocybin and psilocin, usually by liquid chromatography (HPLC or LC-MS/MS), and reports them as mg per gram or % of the sample.
Colour reagent tests show whether something is present, not how much. They cannot tell potency.
Home semi-quantitative kits (a colour scale read by eye, or with a small photometer) give a rough figure for dried material only. The maker's accuracy claims have not been checked independently here.

A result describes the sample that was tested. Single mushrooms of one grow differed by up to about 23% in a 2026 study, and caps held about twice as much as stems in another, so grind and mix (homogenise) a portion of the batch before sampling if the result is meant for the whole batch.
reading_a_certificate: Look for psilocybin and psilocin reported separately, in mg/g or % of dry weight. 1% = 10 mg/g.

'Total psilocybin' or 'total potential psilocin' combine the two after converting one into the other by molar mass; check which the lab used. This app converts psilocin to psilocybin equivalents by x 1.39 (284.25 / 204.27 g/mol).
Check whether the result is per dry weight or per sample as received; a sample with water in it reads lower per gram.
Check what was sent: whole mushrooms, caps, stems or powder, and whether it was ground and mixed.
To use a result, open the batch in the mushroom calculator, enter the psilocybin % and psilocin %, choose 'Your lab test' and note the lab name and date.

services.name: ACS Laboratory
services.tests: Potency of psilocybin, psilocin, baeocystin, norbaeocystin, norpsilocin, aeruginascin, 4-HO-TMT, 4-HT, harmine and harmane, plus contaminants and moisture.
services.eligibility: Its FAQ lists psilocybin mushroom testing for DEA-licensed clients only.

services.name: miraculix Psilocybin QTest
services.tests: Total psilocybin + psilocin as psilocybin equivalents in dried mushrooms, truffles or mycelium; about 150 mg of ground material; colour chart from 0 to 2.4% (0-24 mg/g) in 0.6% steps, or a separate photometer. Not for fresh mushrooms. The maker states agreement with HPLC within +/-10%.
services.eligibility: Sold through the maker's EU and US web shops; check whether it may be shipped to you.

services.name: Bunk Police Psilocybin QTest Kit
services.tests: Single-use kit giving the percentage and mg of psilocybin/psilocin in dried material (not fresh mushrooms), read against a colour chart. The page does not name the maker.
services.eligibility: US seller; the page says a tested sample should not be considered safe.

services.name: Oregon ORELAP-accredited psilocybin labs
services.tests: Labs that test psilocybin products in Oregon's regulated program must be accredited by ORELAP. The state's list (updated 16 Dec 2024) named Rose City Laboratories.
services.eligibility: For Oregon's licensed psilocybin program. Whether any listed lab accepts samples from the public was not confirmed.

checked_not_listed.name: Energy Control International (Spain)
checked_not_listed.reason: Offers anonymous quantitative analysis to users, but its submission page does not mention mushrooms or psilocybin, so mushroom potency testing could not be confirmed.

checked_not_listed.name: DrugsData (USA)
checked_not_listed.reason: Its site says new sample submissions are not being accepted.

checked_not_listed.name: Substance, Victoria BC (Canada)
checked_not_listed.reason: Free drug checking; its page does not say whether mushrooms are accepted and says it cannot give exact percentages.

checked_not_listed.name: checkit! Vienna (Austria)
checked_not_listed.reason: Free, anonymous drug checking; its page does not mention mushrooms.
